notes.subject: רעה
notes.rationale: 'He pastures/grazes on' vs KJV 'he evil entreateth' (rēaʿ 'evil' read into rōʿeh 'shepherd'); the shepherd-verb is kept here.

notes.subject: subject of verse
notes.rationale: The doer is the wicked man of Job's survey (JPS) vs God (implicit in some renderings).

notes.subject: denbali ni kelemuso
notes.rationale: Verse names the vulnerable addressees of oppression — barren woman and widow — stock Tanakh pairs.

translation: A bɛ denbali min tɛ den bɔ da ⟨a ka dun⟩, nka a tɛ kelemuso ma ɲɛ di.

tokens.gloss: a bɛ ... da u ka dun
